request.style: English, Southern gospel male quartet, high tenor, lead, baritone and a booming bass singer trading lines, honky-tonk gospel piano, upright bass, brushed drums, bright major key, bouncy shuffle, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elijah walked with Elisha by the river Jordan's side
Ask me what you want, my son, before I cross the great divide
Elisha said a double portion of your spirit let it be
If you see me when I'm taken, it will come to you, said he

[Chorus]
Swing low, chariot of fire
Horses of fire, carry him higher
Up in a whirlwind, gone in a flash
Elijah went home and he never looked back

[Verse]
As they walked along and talked, the sky began to burn
A chariot came between them and there would be no return
My father, oh my father, cried Elisha on the ground
And he picked up the mantle that came floating softly down

[Chorus]
Swing low, chariot of fire
Horses of fire, carry him higher
Up in a whirlwind, gone in a flash
Elijah went home and he never looked back

[Outro]
He never looked back
No, he never looked back
